name: Blood Strike Rank Tracker
tagline: A live rank / RP / wins overlay for OBS. Offline, transparent, zero game hooks.
features: Transparent 360×90 overlay card built for an OBS Browser Source
Rank badge, ranked points and wins-today, all updated live over Server-Sent Events
Tiny native control panel: pick rank, type RP, tap +/− for wins
Auto-saves every change with crash-safe atomic writes and a backup
Runs fully offline on 127.0.0.1 — never touches the game, no accounts, no telemetry
Single self-contained EXE, no .NET install needed
body: I got tired of retyping my rank in a text source every time I ranked up on stream, so I built this. You keep a small control panel open next to OBS, change your rank, RP or wins, and the overlay updates instantly.
It is completely separate from Blood Strike. It does not read game memory, inject anything, or talk to any server. It is a manual tracker with a pretty face.
Your license key unlocks the app on up to 3 PCs. Payment is crypto only and your key shows up on this site the moment the payment is confirmed.
setup: Download and unzip the folder anywhere. Keep the folder together.
Run Ryvoki Blood Strike Rank Tracker.exe and paste your license key when asked.
In OBS add a Browser Source: URL http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay, width 360, height 90.
Change rank / RP / wins in the control panel. The overlay updates live.
